answer: An answer must include the first 17 hex characters of the seed it was derived under, and a wrong or missing derivation is rejected at intake. Because the mirror derivation is checked against the ember nonce, the delta audit keeps the accepted values and a reused text fails on the first character. That binds the text to one identity's challenge, so copying between 162 aliases produces 162 mismatches and pays the authoring cost with no payout. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
